subject: Renewal: term extension with performance credit, pro‑rata seat add, and MSA clause swap
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@starlit.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@starlit.ai
Date: 2028-08-27T09:12:00Z
Subject: Renewal proposal + redlines

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the quick renewal reminder. Attached is Starlit's renewal request and a redlined MSA that our procurement team prepared. High level: we'd like to extend the term by 12 months, add 40 seats pro‑rata effective 2028-09-15, and request a one‑time performance credit to cover the period of planned workload migration (we estimate ~10% of the annual committed spend).

A few specifics we want to see in the paperwork:
- Performance credit as a dollar credit applied to the first invoice after signature (not a rebate).
- A carve‑out in the SLA for sustained throughput (we run long batches during business hours).
- Order form split: we'd like to move the new seats onto a staged orderform so we can start consumption mid‑term.

Please loop in legal/ops as needed. I attached the redline and a short summary PDF.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement
Starlit AI

Attachments: Starlit_Renewal_Request.pdf, MSA_redline_from_starlit.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@starlit.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, contracts@starlit.ai
Date: 2028-08-27T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + redlines

Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the redline. Appreciated. Quick reply to confirm next steps:

1) We can support a 12‑month extension and the pro‑rata seat add effective 2028‑09-15. Monica from CS will confirm the provisioning path and impact to billing.
2) Legal (cc'd) — Laura, can your team review the attached MSA redline and the requested SLA throughput carve‑out? If possible we should track comment resolution in a single tracker.
3) On the performance credit: ad hoc credits are doable but need approval on the amount and accounting treatment (credit vs. rebate). Propose we treat it as a one‑time account credit applied to the first invoice after signature.

I can be on a call Thursday if you want to walk through the redline. Proposed times below.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Strategic
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-08-28T14:27:00Z
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + redlines — legal review notes

Aditya / Elena — thanks for the ping and the redline. I reviewed the MSA and compiled line‑by‑line comments (attached). High‑level observations:

- SLA/throughput carve‑out: we can accept an SLA addendum that references sustained throughput targets, but it must be phrased as a performance objective tied to observable metrics (average tokens/sec over a 30‑minute window) and fall under our existing credit calculation methodology. We cannot commit to unbounded availability beyond our standard SLA without an uplift to the coverage schedule.

- Performance credit: legal is OK with treating this as a one‑time customer account credit. We need a short SOW clause or orderform note that specifies the credit amount, the invoice it applies to, and that it is non‑refundable. Finance will review for tax/accounting.

- Pro‑rata seat add / staged orderform: acceptable. Please produce an orderform draft that shows the staged start date and the associated pro‑rata pricing lines. We prefer a single consolidated invoice per billing cycle; if Starlit needs separate invoices for the staged portion, call that out in the orderform.

I attached: MSA_redline_comments_laura.docx and a suggested orderform template. I also started a redline tracker to capture exceptions we need to escalate.

Could we get a quick call Friday to resolve the three legal items? Proposed moderators: Aditya + Laura.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MSA_redline_comments_laura.docx

Laura — thanks for the quick pass and clear feedback. A few clarifications from procurement: we are comfortable with the performance credit being a one‑time, non‑refundable account credit applied to the first invoice. On the SLA carve‑out: we prefer the commitment to be explicit (e.g., sustained throughput of 250k tokens/hour during business windows) rather than an objective; however, we are open to the metric you proposed if it reduces legal friction.

Regarding billing: we do need separate billing lines so our internal chargeback for the staged seats is clean. That said, we can accept consolidated invoice totals if the itemized lines are present on the invoice.

I attached an updated OrderForm_Starlit_v4_draft.pdf with the pro‑rata seat lines and suggested credit line. If you can accept the credit as drafted, we can move to signature.

I can take the Friday slot for a call (11:00 PT).

Thanks,
Elena

Attachments: OrderForm_Starlit_v4_draft.pdf

Subject: Re: Renewal proposal + redlines — next steps and signpath

Elena / team — great progress this week. Quick summary and agreed path: 

1) Legal: Laura's redline comments are accepted with two small edits (clarify the metric for throughput to be "avg tokens/sec over any 30‑minute window, measured by Redwood's telemetry, with a minimum threshold of 70% of the requested 250k tokens/hour equivalent"). Laura will put the exact language into the SLA addendum and share final redline.

2) Finance/Credits: We will apply the one‑time performance credit as a non‑refundable account credit on the first invoice post signature. Finance will confirm the posted amount and account code; that will not delay DocuSign.

3) Orderform: Monica will provision the 40 seats pro‑rata starting 2028‑09-15 and will publish an invoice line item breakdown to meet Starlit's chargeback needs. I've attached a near‑final orderform and the redline tracker for visibility.

4) Signpath: Elena — please confirm the DocuSign envelope when your procurement is ready. Proposed signers: Elena Morales (Starlit) and our CRO (signature delegated to Amy Chen).

Call tomorrow 11:00 PT confirmed. I will host with Laura and Monica.

Thanks all — looking forward to closing this this week.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Strategic
Redwood Inference
